:::{#exm-log-odds-auto}
#### Log-odds that a car in the Auto data is American

For the [event](#def-event) $A$ of @exm-odds-auto,
the [log-odds](#def-log-odds) of @def-log-odds are:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
log(p_american / (1 - p_american))
```

The log-odds are positive because the [odds](#def-odds) exceed 1:
an American car is more likely than not.
:::
